claims: One Battle After Another won Best Picture at the 98th Academy Awards on March 15, 2026.
Paul Thomas Anderson directed One Battle After Another.
Paul Thomas Anderson won Best Director at the 98th Academy Awards.
Paul Thomas Anderson won Best Adapted Screenplay at the 98th Academy Awards.
Michael B. Jordan won Best Actor for Sinners at the 98th Academy Awards.
Jessie Buckley won Best Actress for Hamnet at the 98th Academy Awards.
Ryan Coogler won Best Original Screenplay for Sinners at the 98th Academy Awards.
Sean Penn won Best Supporting Actor for One Battle After Another at the 98th Academy Awards.
